title: Phase 2 geography reconciliation boundary
summary: Country/territory in ISO scope is distinct from sovereignty, jurisdiction, statistical area, sales territory and locality. A place label is not a globally unique key. Country context is necessary but insufficient for same-named settlements; postcode associations can be many-to-many. Retain leading zeros and historical/category scope. Implement a versioned raw-value-to-reviewed-code bridge with ambiguity and unmatched outputs before external lookup.
